caption: One input, one hidden neuron, one output neuron.

eyebrow: Chain rule: the easy weight first
code:
dL_dyhat  = yhat - y        # -0.5480
dyhat_dw2 = h                #  0.6457

dL_dw2 = dL_dyhat * dyhat_dw2
# -0.3538
caption: w2 sits next to the output — two links in the chain.

eyebrow: Chain rule: through the hidden layer
code:
dyhat_dh = w2             # 0.7000
dh_dz1   = dsigmoid(z1)   # 0.2288
dz1_dw1  = x               # 1.5000

dL_dw1 = dL_dyhat * dyhat_dh * dh_dz1 * dz1_dw1
# -0.1317
caption: w1 needs four links — the error flows back through h.
A numerical gradient confirms the chain-rule math.
The loss nearly halved after a single update.
